packs.name: Aurora
packs.description: A night sky with drifting northern lights behind a frosted-glass, spatial interface: a floating dock, glass windows, a Sky home with a glowing storage ring, a filmstrip of days, a cockpit-style six-camera Viewer and an orbiting Encoder.
packs.author: Aurora

packs.name: Daylight
packs.description: A calm, friendly interface: a Today page that answers your questions first, a calendar of footage, a big six-camera Viewer, guided conversions, light and dark looks.
packs.author: Daylight pack

packs.name: Flux
packs.description: A dense, dark control console for people who want every number: live canvas telemetry, a command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K), keyboard shortcuts everywhere, sortable tables, a six-camera synced viewer with telemetry and a lane-level encoder view.
packs.author: Flux

packs.name: Horizon
packs.description: Retro-futuristic synthwave cockpit: neon HUD panels over an endless grid that runs toward a setting sun. Dashboard instrument cluster, track-list footage, heads-up Viewer and a dyno-room Encoder.
packs.author: Sentry Six Manager examples
